title: Standings & aggregates double-count overlapping datasets (no dedup)
evidence: soccer.c:45 loads all 5 match files (Brasileirao_Matches + novo_campeonato_brasileiro 2003-2019 + BR-Football-Dataset), whose fixtures overlap, without deduplication; total = 23954 = 4180+1337+1255+10296+6886 (test_soccer.c:5 asserts db.match_count==23954). _factual.json shows 2019 Serie A with Atletico-MG on 96 pts and Flamengo listed twice at 90 pts — roughly double a 38-game season.
suggestion: Deduplicate matches on (date, home, away) allowing +/-1 day before aggregating, so each fixture is counted once.

title: Standings key does not normalize -UF state suffix, splitting each club into duplicate rows
evidence: soccer.c:56 keys teams via eq_norm (soccer.c:48) which lowercases/strips accents but NOT the trailing state suffix; soccer_team_matches (soccer.c:47) DOES strip a 2-char suffix. So 'Flamengo' and 'Flamengo-RJ' become distinct rows. _factual.json raw shows Flamengo/Flamengo-RJ, Palmeiras/Palmeiras-SP, Santos/Santos-SP all duplicated, and only 10 of 20 clubs resolved.
suggestion: Use the suffix-stripping normalization (as in soccer_team_matches) when building the standings key so name variants collapse to one club.

title: BR-Football-Dataset competition strings not mapped to canonical names
evidence: soccer.c:38 stores the raw v[0] tournament string as the competition for BR-Football rows, so a competition filter for 'Brasileirao'/'Copa do Brasil'/'Libertadores' does not match those ~10k rows (only Brasileirao_Matches/Cup/Libertadores rows carry the canonical tags set at soccer.c:35-37).
suggestion: Map the BR-Football tournament column onto the canonical competition names, or exclude it from competition-filtered queries.

title: BR-Football rows have season hardcoded to 0, so season filter silently drops them
evidence: soccer.c:38 passes season=0 for kind==3 (BR-Football has no season column); soccer.c:50 filters m->season!=atoi(season), so any season query excludes all ~10k BR-Football rows without warning.
suggestion: Derive season/year from the BR-Football date column, or document that these rows are season-agnostic.

title: date_from/date_to compare heterogeneous date formats as raw strings
evidence: soccer.c:50 compares m->date lexicographically, but dates are stored in mixed formats across sources (ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' from Brasileirao/Libertadores vs 'DD/MM/YYYY' from novo_campeonato at soccer.c:39), so a date range straddling formats yields wrong inclusion.
suggestion: Normalize all dates to ISO at load time before storing, then string comparison is valid.

title: Gherkin feature file has no runner/step definitions
evidence: tests/features/match_queries.feature defines 2 scenarios but nothing executes them; only tests/test_soccer.c runs (via Makefile `test`).
suggestion: Either wire the .feature to a BDD runner or treat it as documentation; the C test already covers the behaviors.
